analysis:
Integration pass over all 28 units. The PR is a Gemma 4 prefill-geometry change: a 2048-token plain chunk, a 4096-token step budget and a 512 ceiling for bidirectional media. It adds the env overrides DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS. It adds PrefillGeometry to ProductionBuild and benchmark schema 5, and it forwards the two env keys through LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys. Tests, docs and profiling scripts accompany it. The replayed integration_source is documentation only (changelog, hardware-support, inference.md, cli-reference.md), with 133 source units omitted. I could not directly re-read most of the Swift code, so the per-unit analyses of EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift, +Production.swift and LaunchAgent.swift are accepted as evidence only, not verified.

Threat-model fit: nothing touches the coordinator WebSocket (TB-002), attestation (TB-009/TB-011), keys (A-002/A-003), App Attest authorization (T-053), or the fan helper (TB-010).

T-041 prefix cache: cacheSalt scoping, HMAC lookup tags, the 30-minute TTL, the DBK3 format and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate are unchanged. Docs say the overrides enter the complete-checkpoint numerics fingerprint, so cache identity is preserved. The chunk size can shift TTFT characteristics, but SEC-035 is already an accepted risk and no new channel was identified.

New env passthrough: the two keys are numeric, non-secret and operator-controlled (ADV-001/TB-003), and the allowlist test excludes unrelated secrets. No privilege gain.

Availability and memory (TB-007, T-010, T-029): the wider chunk is on Gemma 4 only by default. The docs claim paged-pool maxPrefillChunk is unchanged (max(chunk, stripe)), media is capped at 512, and the measured peak of 3.73 GiB sits within the 5.5 GiB reserve. The docs admit that GPT-OSS and Qwen already exceed their floors at eight 32k prompts, a pre-existing gap. Parsing and bounds of the overrides, the media-block floor of 1120, and the contiguous-KV Gemma behavior (wait or preempt instead of 512 retry) are claimed in docs and tests but not verified against source here.

No qualifying finding. Residual: code-side memory-admission invariants (ring sizing, step-budget clamping vs. calibrated limits) deserve a source-level check, but the evidence shows no concrete regression.
